correctness.rationale: Specified LCF graph, all twelve BFS shortest-path tables and all 4096 vertex masks are exhaustively reconstructed. 56 free-face collapses each check uniqueness of coface; tree contraction and 28 nonabelian relator cancellations yield 18 free loops and four nullattached two-cells, proving an integral wedge rather than only Betti ranks. All 48 adjacency-preserving permutations and all signed simplex orbits are enumerated; invariant boundary has rank one, giving quotient rational homology with exact characteristic-zero transfer. The packaged stdlib verifier is replayed from its actual decoded bytes.

Counting/extremal results do not determine nonabelian attaching maps.

value.rationale: The Franklin graph is a standard, highly symmetric twelve-vertex cubic graph with a historically meaningful Klein-bottle coloring role. Its no-three-on-geodesic complex has a nontrivial mixed-dimensional integral homotopy type (18 circles and four 2-spheres), an unknown-to-indexed-results exact invariant that is not inferred from the general-position cardinality or face polynomial. The rational automorphism orbit classification is an additional symmetry-sensitive invariant not determined by wedge ranks alone. The precise single-graph computation is self-contained and reusable as an integral benchmark, without unsupported broad generalizations.
